exceptions.scope: Runtime library preact 11.0.1 (preact, preact/hooks, preact/jsx-runtime) in the browser bundle dist/client
exceptions.rationale: Preact is the smallest maintained component library that keeps the form-heavy editing interface declarative (ADR-0006). Its measured marginal cost is 5,350 bytes gzip, 350 bytes over the 5,000-byte per-library ceiling. Plain DOM code would replace it with more application code (§9.4).

measurement.method: vite build of the client with and without preact externalized; gzip level 9 over dist/client/assets/*.js; 2026-10-19

exceptions.removal: Remove when a Preact release or a replacement renderer measures at or under 5,000 bytes gzip by the same method; otherwise renew with a fresh measurement.
exceptions.enforcement: npm run check:standards fails after the expiry date; npm run verify:build holds the whole bundle to scripts/build-baseline.json × 1.05.

exceptions.scope: Per-library scoping of catalog, mirror, sync and change rows
exceptions.rationale: Scoping is enforced by Postgres row-level security (integration-tested) and by library_id predicates in MODEL queries. 1.0.1.0 C-10 additionally requires the invariant in STATE or PURE with unit tests so the same code is correct where RLS is unavailable. No PURE scoping predicate exists yet.
exceptions.removal: Add a PURE scope predicate (or query-builder guard) used by every library-scoped MODEL query, with scope-* unit tests; then remove.
exceptions.enforcement: RLS integration tests continue to run; manual review of new MODEL queries until then.

exceptions.rationale: verify:build checks the browser bundle for secrets and connection strings; no scanner covers the repository tree (server source, tests, fixtures, workflows).
exceptions.removal: Add secretlint (recommended preset) or gitleaks to npm run build or the CI workflow; then remove.
